verdict.rationale: AutoGen is an agent framework, so an official scaffolding CLI or template is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only package installation (pip install) and AutoGen Studio's visual team builder with export to Python code. Neither is a documented one-command project scaffold from an official CLI or template.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a coding agent scaffold a new agent project from an official CLI or template in one command
